_readme: The final escape. Each route runs three sequential checks against different stats; failing a step damages the crew and raises Heat but does not immediately end the run - you need to pass at least 'required_passes' of the three. 'heat_modifier' is added to every step's difficulty as Heat rises, so a loud run makes every route harder. Add a route by copying a block.

routes.name: The Tunnel
routes.tagline: Down, along, and up. Ninety metres of other people's plumbing.

steps.title: Find the breach point
steps.success: The soft section is exactly where the blueprint promised. The first block comes away clean.
steps.failure: You dig in the wrong place for forty minutes and hit a footing that was poured in 1961 and means it.

steps.title: Dig through
steps.success: Three hours of filthy, silent, magnificent work. The tunnel goes.
steps.failure: A partial collapse. Everybody is fine. Everybody is also under a certain amount of prison.

steps.title: Cross the last stretch
steps.success: Out into a drainage ditch, in the dark, in a field. Nobody says anything for a full minute.
steps.failure: You come up inside the perimeter lighting, which is the one place the tunnel was supposed to avoid.

routes.victory: You surface in a wet field four hundred metres beyond the wall, covered in something nobody will discuss, and walk away from the worst-run institution in the county.
routes.defeat: The tunnel was good. The tunnel was genuinely good. It simply came up eleven metres short, inside the lit strip, in front of a tower.

routes.name: The Disguise
routes.tagline: Walk out of the front. Confidently. Wearing somebody else's trousers.

steps.title: Produce the paperwork
steps.success: A transfer order, a vehicle authorisation, and a lanyard. All of it is fake. None of it looks it.
steps.failure: The form is right. The reference number is not, and the reference number is the only part anybody ever checks.

steps.title: Clear the checkpoint
steps.success: You complain about the paperwork before he can. He agrees with you enthusiastically and waves you through.
steps.failure: He asks one follow-up question. Just one. It is a very good question.

steps.title: Reach the vehicle gate
steps.success: Four hundred metres of open tarmac, walked at exactly the speed of somebody who is allowed to be there.
steps.failure: Somebody breaks into a jog. Nobody on staff has ever jogged here. It is noticed instantly.

routes.victory: You drive out of the staff gate in a van you are not authorised to operate, waving at a man who waves back, and nobody realises for six hours.
routes.defeat: The uniforms were perfect. The documents were perfect. Somebody said 'cheers, boss' to the actual boss.

routes.name: The Riot
routes.tagline: Make the building somebody else's problem, then leave during it.

steps.title: Light the fuse
steps.success: Four hundred men decide, more or less simultaneously, that they have had enough of the gravy.
steps.failure: You give the speech. It is a good speech. Nobody moves. It is the longest eleven seconds of your life.

steps.title: Hold the corridor
steps.success: Two doors, one bench, and a wall of your largest people. Nothing gets past.
steps.failure: The corridor is held. Briefly. Then it is extremely not held.

steps.title: Slip out in the confusion
steps.success: In the smoke and the shouting nobody counts anybody. You walk out of a fire door that was propped for ventilation.
steps.failure: In the smoke and the shouting, somebody does count. Somebody always counts.

routes.victory: You leave through a fire exit during the largest disturbance in the facility's history, which is still, technically, being investigated.
routes.defeat: The riot was a triumph. It was such a triumph that every exit in the building was sealed within ninety seconds, including yours.

routes.name: The Stupid Plan
routes.tagline: Nobody can explain it. Nobody has agreed to it. It is happening.

steps.title: Commit to it
steps.success: Against every reasonable expectation, the first part works. Nobody is more surprised than the crew.
steps.failure: The first part does not work. The first part was never going to work. That was always the risk with the first part.

steps.title: Go before anybody thinks about it
steps.success: Momentum carries you through a set of circumstances that would not survive a second's thought.
steps.failure: Somebody thinks about it. Out loud. The whole thing collapses under mild scrutiny.

steps.title: The bit nobody planned
steps.success: A laundry van, a propped gate, and a delivery driver who has decided he does not get paid enough to notice things.
steps.failure: The bit nobody planned turns out to have been the bit that needed planning.

routes.victory: You escape inside a laundry cart, on a van, driven by a man who will later tell police he assumed it was a training exercise. No part of this should have worked. All of it did.
routes.defeat: It was a stupid plan. Everybody said so at the time. It has been recorded, in the incident log, as 'the stupid plan', by a guard who was laughing.
